messages.subject: Box and whisker plot export
parts:
Hello, 

I have a matrix with 100 numerical variables and 1 categorical variable for 100 samples. After ANOVA analysis of this matrix, I am looking for a way to export all the box and whisker plots for hundred variables as separate jpeg files having variable name as filename (eg variableX  ----> variableX.jpeg). Can anybody help me?  

Dinesh

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: Box and whisker plot export
parts:
This is untested since I don't have your data. I'm assuming that your categorical factor is in column 1 and your numerical variables are in the columns thereafter. 


colstart=2

colend <- ncol(data)


for (i in colstart:colend){

plot<-ggplot()+

geom_boxplot(data=data, aes_string(x= paste(colnames(data)[1]), 

                y= paste(colnames(data)[i]))+

theme_bw()

#save plot

ggsave(sprintf("Boxplot.%s.png", colnames(melon.data)[i], width=6, height=6)

}




HTH, 

Brandon
